messages:
Lina (AE): Quick sync for Orion Bank POC94 they want per-subsidiary domain ownership, SCIM whitelist, SAML mapping, and single-bill. Short bullets pls.
Ibrahim (Orion IT): Corporate wants single invoice but each subsidiary must manage their own domain and admins. Also: SCIM must not provision all users.
Marco (SE): We can do delegated domain verification via per-namespace DNS TXT (preferred) or email to an admin alias. Example TXT: `_rdw-verify=9c4f2a`. Verify with `dig TXT _rdw-verify.sub.domain.com`. No DNS creds required.
Tasha (Security): Confirm we don't persist raw SAML assertions and whether we can disable last_login on user objects.
Marco (SE): We don't store raw assertions by default; we log auth events. last_login persistence can be disabled per-tenant on Private/Dedicated; hosted may require an add-on.
Ibrahim (Orion IT): For SCIM, we want link-only for most subsidiaries and create-on-provision for a sandbox team. Also whitelist only netops/app-admins/audit.
Marco (SE): Supported. We'll provide server-side whitelist and recommend IdP provisioning filters. Link-only returns 404 for unknown users; create-on-provision will POST a user.
finance-bot: Pricing note: reserved capacity discounts apply at contract level; we can split costs by namespace and report per-namespace token usage. Finance needs tokens/day and peak rps.
Lina (AE): Action items: Marco 94 send SAML SP metadata + SCIM whitelist sample + curl test; Tasha 94 short security FAQ (KMS/HSM, retention options); Ibrahim 94 share traffic estimates and per-subsidiary create/link preference. POC kickoff Tue 11:00am UTC.
Ibrahim (Orion IT): We'll send estimates tomorrow. Can you include a tiny SCIM test curl for link-only?
Marco (SE): Sample (link-only):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"alex@subs.orion.com","emails":[{"value":"alex@subs.orion.com"}],"externalId":"ext-22"}'
```
Lina (AE): Thanks team 94 I'll bundle artifacts and send to Ibrahim after Tasha's FAQ lands. :thumbsup;
